c01-s01-p02.source_text: When I was six, I found a picture I couldn't stop looking at. It was in a book about the forest: a huge snake swallowing an animal.
c01-s01-p02.legacy_image_policy: Reference/comparison only; never substitute an existing finished page for this component recipe.

c01-s01-p03.note: Makes the six-month sleep described in the book visible. Actual scene and physical paper/contact states remain intact. No animal on the room floor.
c01-s01-p03.source_text: The book said these snakes swallowed their food whole. After a meal, they couldn't move. They slept for six months!
c01-s01-p03.legacy_image_policy: Reference/comparison only; never substitute an existing finished page for this component recipe.

c01-s01-p04.note: Book now closed. Insert an incomplete stage of Drawing One inside the blank sheet; preserve master mark geometry.
c01-s01-p04.source_text: Six months! I kept thinking about that snake and all the adventures in the forest. At last, I took my pencil and began to draw.
c01-s01-p04.legacy_image_policy: Reference/comparison only; never substitute an existing finished page for this component recipe.

c01-s02-p01.note: The child at right presents Drawing One leftward to the same two adults visible on the next page. Keep the exact measured child, paper and room. This presentation and first-response beat intentionally hold the same assembled scene.
c01-s02-p01.source_text: I called it Drawing Number One. To me, it was wonderful. Now I wanted to see what the grown-ups thought.
c01-s02-p01.legacy_image_policy: Reference/comparison only; never substitute an existing finished page for this component recipe.

c01-s02-p02.note: Makes the mistaken interpretation visible on the answer page, contrasting with the child’s explanation next. Actual scene and physical paper/contact states remain intact. No physical hat in the room; do not replace Drawing One on the paper.
c01-s02-p02.source_text: "Are you frightened?" I asked. "Frightened? It's only a hat," they said.
c01-s02-p02.legacy_image_policy: Reference/comparison only; never substitute an existing finished page for this component recipe.

c01-s02-p03.note: Shows what the child meant, distinct from the adults’ hat. Actual scene and physical paper/contact states remain intact. The physical paper remains Drawing One; no physical elephant or second sheet.
c01-s02-p03.source_text: A hat? It wasn't a hat at all. My snake had an elephant inside! But the grown-ups could only see the outside.
c01-s02-p03.legacy_image_policy: Reference/comparison only; never substitute an existing finished page for this component recipe.

c01-s03-p01.note: First physical Drawing Two; no extra live elephant.
c01-s03-p01.source_text: So I drew another picture. This time, I showed the inside of the snake, with the elephant in its big round body. Drawing Number Two.
c01-s03-p01.legacy_image_policy: Reference/comparison only; never substitute an existing finished page for this component recipe.

c01-s03-p02.note: Completed Drawing Two on one held sheet; adults gently redirect him.
c01-s03-p02.source_text: Now they could see the elephant. I waited. "Put those snakes away," they said. "Study geography, history, math, and grammar instead."
c01-s03-p02.legacy_image_policy: Reference/comparison only; never substitute an existing finished page for this component recipe.

c01-s03-p03.note: Pencil visibly rests on table; no continuing drawing grip.
c01-s03-p03.source_text: I was only six, and already I was giving up my life as an artist. I put down my pencil.
c01-s03-p03.legacy_image_policy: Reference/comparison only; never substitute an existing finished page for this component recipe.

c01-s03-p04.note: Hands support cheeks, pencil and book remain at rest; no new drawing.
c01-s03-p04.source_text: Grown-ups need so many explanations. And when you're six, explaining everything, again and again, is very tiring.
c01-s03-p04.legacy_image_policy: Reference/comparison only; never substitute an existing finished page for this component recipe.

c01-s04-p01.note: Adult day flight nose and gaze LEFT; sole occupied cockpit, closed cowling.
c01-s04-p01.source_text: Years passed. I chose a different life and learned to fly planes. Since then, I've flown over many parts of the world.
c01-s04-p01.legacy_image_policy: Reference/comparison only; never substitute an existing finished page for this component recipe.

c01-s04-p02.note: Visualizes the user-requested mental geography/navigation aid while retaining the night flight. Actual scene and physical paper/contact states remain intact. No map held in pilot hands; no new flight location, labels, borders or exact route.
c01-s04-p02.source_text: And yes, geography has helped. One look, and I know: China or Arizona. That's useful when you're lost in the dark.
c01-s04-p02.legacy_image_policy: Reference/comparison only; never substitute an existing finished page for this component recipe.

c01-s04-p03.source_text: I've met many grown-ups in different countries. I've listened to all their important talk. And I still remember why I put down my pencil.
c01-s04-p03.legacy_image_policy: Reference/comparison only; never substitute an existing finished page for this component recipe.

c01-s05-p01.source_text: But sometimes I meet someone and think, "Perhaps this one will understand." I still have Drawing Number One. So I show it to them.
c01-s05-p01.legacy_image_policy: Reference/comparison only; never substitute an existing finished page for this component recipe.

c01-s05-p02.note: Repeats the same misunderstanding years later. Actual scene and physical paper/contact states remain intact. No physical hat; Drawing One stays unchanged in the pilot’s hands.
c01-s05-p02.source_text: I wait for their answer. "A hat," they say. Always a hat.
c01-s05-p02.legacy_image_policy: Reference/comparison only; never substitute an existing finished page for this component recipe.

c01-s05-p03.source_text: After that, I say nothing more about snakes, forests, or stars. We talk about work instead. About money. About clothes.
c01-s05-p03.legacy_image_policy: Reference/comparison only; never substitute an existing finished page for this component recipe.

c01-s06-p01.source_text: And now they're pleased with me. Such a sensible man! We understand each other so well. At least, that's what they think.
c01-s06-p01.legacy_image_policy: Reference/comparison only; never substitute an existing finished page for this component recipe.

c01-s06-p02.source_text: There were people all around me. But no one I could really talk to.
c01-s06-p02.legacy_image_policy: Reference/comparison only; never substitute an existing finished page for this component recipe.

2.title: Draw Me a Sheep
2.notes: First night alone precedes the sunrise meeting. The prince is calm, never a starving lost child. All sheep are drawings; the box contains an unseen sheep. Reuse the exact five drawing masters on blank paper. Keep the aircraft parked, one empty cockpit, two stopped blades and open supported hood.

Pilot alone; prince absent before the morning meeting.

c02-s01-p02.note: Use the later shared standing pilot only if needed; do not generate a duplicate. Scarce water is not a spill.
c02-s01-p02.source_text: Six years ago, my plane broke down in the Sahara Desert. There was no one with me. No passengers. No one to help with the engine.
c02-s01-p02.legacy_image_policy: Reference/comparison only; never substitute an existing finished page for this component recipe.

c02-s01-p03.note: Pilot actually repairs engine; no prince, passengers, spilled water or duplicate parked aircraft.
c02-s01-p03.source_text: I had to repair it myself. My water could last only a week. Out there, getting the engine to work meant staying alive.
c02-s01-p03.legacy_image_policy: Reference/comparison only; never substitute an existing finished page for this component recipe.

c02-s01-p04.source_text: That first night, I slept on the sand, a thousand miles from any town. A sailor alone in the middle of the ocean could hardly feel farther from home.
c02-s01-p04.legacy_image_policy: Reference/comparison only; never substitute an existing finished page for this component recipe.

c02-s02-p01.source_text: At sunrise, a small voice woke me. "Please, draw me a sheep." I sat up. "What?" "Draw me a sheep."
c02-s02-p01.legacy_image_policy: Reference/comparison only; never substitute an existing finished page for this component recipe.

c02-s02-p02.source_text: A little boy stood there, watching me very seriously. He did not look lost, hungry, thirsty, or afraid. But there was nothing around us except sand.
c02-s02-p02.legacy_image_policy: Reference/comparison only; never substitute an existing finished page for this component recipe.

c02-s02-p03.note: Narrator’s portrait on paper; not a second physical prince or a new meeting.
c02-s02-p03.source_text: I have tried to draw him for you. My picture is not nearly as lovely as he was. Remember, the grown-ups stopped my drawing lessons when I was six.
c02-s02-p03.legacy_image_policy: Reference/comparison only; never substitute an existing finished page for this component recipe.

c02-s02-p04.source_text: "What are you doing here?" He answered slowly, as if nothing could be more important. "Please. Draw me a sheep."
c02-s02-p04.legacy_image_policy: Reference/comparison only; never substitute an existing finished page for this component recipe.

c02-s02-p05.source_text: There I was, with a broken plane and hardly any water. But I took out my paper and pen. What else could I do with such a strange little visitor?
c02-s02-p05.legacy_image_policy: Reference/comparison only; never substitute an existing finished page for this component recipe.

c02-s02-p06.source_text: "I studied geography, history, math, and grammar," I said. "I don't know how to draw." "That doesn't matter. Draw me a sheep."
c02-s02-p06.legacy_image_policy: Reference/comparison only; never substitute an existing finished page for this component recipe.

c02-s03-p01.note: Only Drawing One on the paper; no live elephant.
c02-s03-p01.source_text: I had never drawn a sheep. So I drew the picture I knew best: my snake from the outside. "No, no! I don't want an elephant inside a snake!"
c02-s03-p01.legacy_image_policy: Reference/comparison only; never substitute an existing finished page for this component recipe.

c02-s03-p02.note: Contrasts his correct recognition with Chapter 1’s grown-ups. Actual scene and physical paper/contact states remain intact. Physical sheet remains Drawing One; never reveal the later boxed sheep.
c02-s03-p02.source_text: "That snake is dangerous, and the elephant is much too big. Where I live, everything is very small. I need a sheep." At last, someone could see my elephant.
c02-s03-p02.legacy_image_policy: Reference/comparison only; never substitute an existing finished page for this component recipe.

c02-s03-p03.source_text: I tried to draw a sheep. The little prince studied it. "No. This one looks sick. Please draw another."
c02-s03-p03.legacy_image_policy: Reference/comparison only; never substitute an existing finished page for this component recipe.

c02-s03-p04.source_text: I tried again. This time he smiled. "That's a ram. Look at its horns." So I began a third drawing.
c02-s03-p04.legacy_image_policy: Reference/comparison only; never substitute an existing finished page for this component recipe.

c02-s03-p05.source_text: "This one is too old," he said. "I want a sheep that will live a long time." Three drawings. Still no sheep.
c02-s03-p05.legacy_image_policy: Reference/comparison only; never substitute an existing finished page for this component recipe.

c02-s04-p01.note: Impatient offer before the child brightens; box remains a drawing with an unseen sheep.
c02-s04-p01.source_text: My engine was waiting. I was losing patience. I drew a box, with a few holes in its side. "There. Your sheep is inside."
c02-s04-p01.legacy_image_policy: Reference/comparison only; never substitute an existing finished page for this component recipe.

c02-s04-p02.source_text: His whole face brightened. "Yes! That's just what I wanted. Do you think it needs much grass?" "Why?" "Because my home is very small."
c02-s04-p02.legacy_image_policy: Reference/comparison only; never substitute an existing finished page for this component recipe.

c02-s04-p03.note: Do not reveal the imagined sleeping sheep.
c02-s04-p03.source_text: "There will be enough," I said. "I've given you a very small sheep." He bent over the picture. "Not so very small. Look! It's asleep."
c02-s04-p03.legacy_image_policy: Reference/comparison only; never substitute an existing finished page for this component recipe.

c02-s04-p04.note: Quiet meeting resolution, no new event.
c02-s04-p04.source_text: And that was how I met the little prince.
c02-s04-p04.legacy_image_policy: Reference/comparison only; never substitute an existing finished page for this component recipe.

3.title: Where Do You Come From?
3.notes: Continue the same daytime camp, outfits and box drawing. “Fell out of the sky” is dialogue, not a second crash. String/post are proposals, not actual tethered sheep. Final sadness remains unexplained.

c03-s01-p02.source_text: The little prince had question after question. My questions were another matter. He hardly seemed to hear them. I learned his story a little at a time.
c03-s01-p02.legacy_image_policy: Reference/comparison only; never substitute an existing finished page for this component recipe.

c03-s01-p03.note: Real parked plane, not an in-world plane drawing.
c03-s01-p03.source_text: "What's that thing?" he asked when he saw my plane. "It isn't just a thing. It flies. It's my airplane." I was rather proud to tell him that.
c03-s01-p03.legacy_image_policy: Reference/comparison only; never substitute an existing finished page for this component recipe.

c03-s01-p04.note: Real parked plane, not an in-world plane drawing.
c03-s01-p04.source_text: I won't try to draw the plane here. That is much too difficult for me. But the little prince was looking at the real one.
c03-s01-p04.legacy_image_policy: Reference/comparison only; never substitute an existing finished page for this component recipe.

c03-s01-p05.source_text: "What? You fell out of the sky?" "Yes." "Oh, that's funny!" He laughed. I did not. I like people to take my troubles seriously.
c03-s01-p05.legacy_image_policy: Reference/comparison only; never substitute an existing finished page for this component recipe.

c03-s02-p01.source_text: "Then you came from the sky too! Which planet is yours?" Too? That little word caught my attention. "Do you come from another planet?"
c03-s02-p01.legacy_image_policy: Reference/comparison only; never substitute an existing finished page for this component recipe.

c03-s02-p02.source_text: He did not answer. He kept looking at my plane. "You can't have come from very far away in that." Then he grew quiet.
c03-s02-p02.legacy_image_policy: Reference/comparison only; never substitute an existing finished page for this component recipe.

c03-s02-p03.source_text: He took the sheep's picture from his pocket and looked at it for a long time. I could wait no longer. "Where is your home? Where will you take your sheep?"
c03-s02-p03.legacy_image_policy: Reference/comparison only; never substitute an existing finished page for this component recipe.

c03-s03-p01.note: String and post remain spoken possibilities; no physical tether.
c03-s03-p01.source_text: "The good thing about this box," he said at last, "is that the sheep can sleep in it at night." "Yes. And I can draw some string and a post for the daytime."
c03-s03-p01.legacy_image_policy: Reference/comparison only; never substitute an existing finished page for this component recipe.

c03-s03-p02.note: String and post remain spoken possibilities; no physical tether.
c03-s03-p02.source_text: "Then you can tie your sheep to the post." "Tie him up? What a strange idea!" "But he could walk away and get lost."
c03-s03-p02.legacy_image_policy: Reference/comparison only; never substitute an existing finished page for this component recipe.

c03-s03-p03.source_text: "Where could he go?" "Anywhere. Straight ahead." The little prince laughed again. "It doesn't matter. Everything is so small where I live."
c03-s03-p03.legacy_image_policy: Reference/comparison only; never substitute an existing finished page for this component recipe.

c03-s03-p04.source_text: Then his voice changed. There was a little sadness in it now. "On my planet, you can't go very far in a straight line."
c03-s03-p04.legacy_image_policy: Reference/comparison only; never substitute an existing finished page for this component recipe.

c04-s02-p02.source_text: Later, a Turkish leader ordered people to wear European clothes. Anyone who refused could be put to death. A cruel rule about clothes, not about the stars.

c04-s03-p01.legacy_image_policy: Reference/comparison only; never substitute an existing finished page for this component recipe.

c04-s03-p02.note: Apply roomstand camera to the complete composition.
c04-s03-p02.source_text: More often, they ask his age, how many brothers he has, how much he weighs, and how much money his father earns. Then they think they know him.
c04-s03-p02.legacy_image_policy: Reference/comparison only; never substitute an existing finished page for this component recipe.

c04-s03-p04.note: Identical house on both pages; price stays in app text.
c04-s03-p04.source_text: Tell them it costs twenty thousand dollars, and they cry, "What a beautiful house!" The price has done what the flowers could not.

c04-s04-p01.source_text: I wish I could begin like this: "Once upon a time, a little prince lived on a very small planet. He needed a sheep."

c26-s02-p02.note: Quiet supported recovery conversation, well/wall background fixed; no rescue fall repeated.

c26-s02-p02.legacy_image_policy: Reference/comparison only; never substitute an existing finished page for this component recipe.

c26-s02-p03.note: Quiet supported recovery conversation, well/wall background fixed; no rescue fall repeated.
c26-s02-p03.source_text: I held him tightly. He was there in my arms, but it felt as though he was already far away, falling somewhere I couldn't reach.
c26-s02-p03.legacy_image_policy: Reference/comparison only; never substitute an existing finished page for this component recipe.

c26-s02-p04.note: Quiet supported recovery conversation, well/wall background fixed; no rescue fall repeated.
c26-s02-p04.source_text: "I have your sheep. And his box. And the muzzle." His smile was sad. I waited for him to feel stronger.
c26-s02-p04.legacy_image_policy: Reference/comparison only; never substitute an existing finished page for this component recipe.

c26-s02-p05.note: Quiet supported recovery conversation, well/wall background fixed; no rescue fall repeated.
c26-s02-p05.source_text: "You were frightened." "I'll be more frightened tonight." The thought of never hearing his laugh again hurt too much. His laugh was like fresh water in the desert.
c26-s02-p05.legacy_image_policy: Reference/comparison only; never substitute an existing finished page for this component recipe.

c26-s02-p06.note: Quiet supported recovery conversation, well/wall background fixed; no rescue fall repeated.
c26-s02-p06.source_text: "Tonight, my star will be above the place where I landed last year." "Tell me this is a bad dream. The snake, the meeting, the star..."
c26-s02-p06.legacy_image_policy: Reference/comparison only; never substitute an existing finished page for this component recipe.

c26-s02-p07.note: Quiet supported recovery conversation, well/wall background fixed; no rescue fall repeated.
c26-s02-p07.source_text: "The most important things are those you can't see." "I know." "A flower on one star makes all the stars lovely. You can look up, and there she is."
c26-s02-p07.legacy_image_policy: Reference/comparison only; never substitute an existing finished page for this component recipe.

c26-s02-p08.note: Quiet supported recovery conversation, well/wall background fixed; no rescue fall repeated.
c26-s02-p08.source_text: "I know." "The water you gave me was like music, because of the rope and the wheel. You remember." "I know."
c26-s02-p08.legacy_image_policy: Reference/comparison only; never substitute an existing finished page for this component recipe.

c26-s03-p01.note: Later evening/night staging; stars remain stars, no literal bells. Smile/laughter needs the specific S09 expression insert rather than repainting a sad face silently.
c26-s03-p01.source_text: "My star is too small for me to show you. That's better. It can be any one of them. You'll like looking at them all. They'll all be your friends."
c26-s03-p01.legacy_image_policy: Reference/comparison only; never substitute an existing finished page for this component recipe.

c26-s03-p02.note: Close laughing child; stars do not literally become bells.
c26-s03-p02.source_text: "I'll give you a present." He laughed. "I love that laugh."
c26-s03-p02.legacy_image_policy: Reference/comparison only; never substitute an existing finished page for this component recipe.

c26-s03-p03.note: Later evening/night staging; stars remain stars, no literal bells. Smile/laughter needs the specific S09 expression insert rather than repainting a sad face silently.
c26-s03-p03.source_text: "That's my present. Like the water. Stars mean different things to different people. For travelers, they show the way. For others, they're little lights."
c26-s03-p03.legacy_image_policy: Reference/comparison only; never substitute an existing finished page for this component recipe.

c26-s03-p04.note: Later evening/night staging; stars remain stars, no literal bells. Smile/laughter needs the specific S09 expression insert rather than repainting a sad face silently.
c26-s03-p04.source_text: "For people who study them, they're questions to answer. For my businessman, they're money. But all those stars are silent. Yours will be different."
c26-s03-p04.legacy_image_policy: Reference/comparison only; never substitute an existing finished page for this component recipe.

c26-s03-p05.note: Close laughing child; stars do not literally become bells.
c26-s03-p05.source_text: "Because I'll live on one of them, and laugh on one of them, you'll hear all the stars laughing. You alone will have stars that can laugh."
c26-s03-p05.legacy_image_policy: Reference/comparison only; never substitute an existing finished page for this component recipe.

c26-s03-p06.note: Close laughing child; stars do not literally become bells.
c26-s03-p06.source_text: He laughed again. "In time, you'll feel less sad. You'll be glad we were friends. You'll always be my friend."
c26-s03-p06.legacy_image_policy: Reference/comparison only; never substitute an existing finished page for this component recipe.

c26-s03-p07.note: Clearly bounded imagined future open-window scene; use roomstand complete camera/scale, not child-room sizing.
c26-s03-p07.source_text: "You'll open your window for the pleasure of it. Your friends will hear you laughing at the stars. They'll think you're quite mad. What a trick I've played on you!"
c26-s03-p07.legacy_image_policy: Reference/comparison only; never substitute an existing finished page for this component recipe.

c26-s03-p08.note: Close laughing child; stars do not literally become bells.
c26-s03-p08.source_text: He laughed once more. He had given me a sky full of little bells that knew how to laugh.
c26-s03-p08.legacy_image_policy: Reference/comparison only; never substitute an existing finished page for this component recipe.

c26-s04-p01.source_text: "Tonight... please don't come. It will look as if I'm suffering. As if I'm dying. You don't need to see that." "I won't leave you."

c26-s04-p02.note: Snake claims are dialogue; no extra bite or experiment.

c26-s04-p03.note: Snake claims are dialogue; no extra bite or experiment.

c26-s04-p04.note: Hand in hand; no physical empty shell, giant wells or bells.

c26-s04-p05.note: Hand in hand; no physical empty shell, giant wells or bells.
c26-s04-p05.source_text: "It will look as if I'm dead. But that won't be true. My body is too heavy. I can't carry it all that way." I said nothing.
c26-s04-p05.legacy_image_policy: Reference/comparison only; never substitute an existing finished page for this component recipe.

c26-s04-p06.note: Hand in hand; no physical empty shell, giant wells or bells.
c26-s04-p06.source_text: "It will be like an old, empty shell. There's no need to be sad about an empty shell." I said nothing.
c26-s04-p06.legacy_image_policy: Reference/comparison only; never substitute an existing finished page for this component recipe.

c26-s04-p07.note: Hand in hand; no physical empty shell, giant wells or bells.
c26-s04-p07.source_text: "You know what will be lovely? When I look at the stars, they'll all be wells with old wheels. They'll all give me water."
c26-s04-p07.legacy_image_policy: Reference/comparison only; never substitute an existing finished page for this component recipe.

c26-s04-p08.note: Hand in hand; no physical empty shell, giant wells or bells.
c26-s04-p08.source_text: "You'll have five hundred million little bells. I'll have five hundred million springs of fresh water." But now he was crying too.
c26-s04-p08.legacy_image_policy: Reference/comparison only; never substitute an existing finished page for this component recipe.

c27-s01-p03.note: Empty sunrise sand as remembered absence. No body, grave, prince arriving home or confirmed resurrection.

c27-s02-p02.note: Fear carried by narrator; no eaten rose.

c27-s02-p03.note: Hope carried by narrator; no factual home reunion.
c27-s02-p03.source_text: Then I tell myself, "Of course not. He covers her every night. He watches his sheep." And I am happy. The stars laugh softly.

c27-s02-p04.note: Possible forgetting/escape stays conditional; no sheep eating flower or real stars turning to tears.

c27-s02-p05.note: Possible forgetting/escape stays conditional; no sheep eating flower or real stars turning to tears.

c27-s02-p05.legacy_image_policy: Reference/comparison only; never substitute an existing finished page for this component recipe.

c27-s03-p01.note: Open question under sky, no answer pictured.
c27-s03-p01.source_text: If you love the little prince, as I do, everything changes with one question. Somewhere, on a planet we have never seen, has a sheep eaten a rose?

c27-s03-p02.note: Open question under sky, no answer pictured.

c27-s04-p02.note: Same recognizable empty desert place; wait under the star, no person added.
c27-s04-p02.source_text: Look carefully, so you will know it if you ever travel through the African desert. If you come here, please don't hurry away. Wait a little, under the star.

c27-s04-p03.source_text: Perhaps a child will come toward you, laughing, with gold hair. Perhaps he will not answer your questions. Then you will know who he is.

coordinate_policy: Approved social recipes use measured layers; all ungenerated page coordinates are authored targets and require measured as-built verification.
future_attachment_policy: Waiting dependency attachments are named but never faked. Copy checked original returns only, preserve source hashes.

1.precedence: Current measured compositions and source review override provisional planned layout envelopes. Six pages retain prior approval; no new approval is inferred.

2.precedence: Current measured compositions and accepted-source records override provisional planned layout envelopes. No user approval is inferred.

SHARED_TH01.status: received, inspected, prepared and used; user review of appearance pending
SHARED_TH01.precedence: This source dependency and style rule supplement the original 167-request planning snapshot.

narrative_staging_review.precedence: Updated per-page recipes and current production overlays override earlier table summaries and original builder output. Preserve future visual QA; planning is not image approval.

storage_policy: Self-contained root-relative paths; one final edition per chapter; retain used raw sources, masks, prepared components, measured layouts, final layers and future request packs. Validate before pruning superseded working files.
generation_authorization_scope: Explicit chapter execution only. Three global attempts maximum, exceptional third requires changed mechanism. Mandatory bounded spend window, one live job, manual chapter approval. Control revision itself submits no jobs.
generation_dependency_waves_usage: Legacy audit dependencies only; execute chapter lineage_execution_order after reuse audit.
